Major roads in North Sydney, the Sydney CBD, Pyrmont, Darlinghurst, Moore Park, Centennial Park and Kingsford will be closed between 2am and 4pm for Sydney Marathon 42km and 10km events on Sunday. 45,000 participants are expected to take part across the two courses with 35,000 taking part in the marathon alone.

Travel across the city will be limited with lengthy detours in place. Sydneysiders are urged to avoid non-essential travel where possible or allow plenty of extra travel time and expect trips to take longer than usual.

Key closure times by suburb area

  • North Sydney closures between 2am and 12pm including sections of Miller St, Pacific Hwy.
  • Sydney Harbour Bridge and Western Distributor closed 3am to 11am. Detour via Harbour Tunnel. Motorists from the Anzac Bridge will be diverted via Bathurst St. Access to the Harbour Tunnel northbound is via the Cross City Tunnel only.
  • Cahill Expressway lanes 7 and 8 and Circular Quay Overpass closed 3am to 11.30am
  • Sydney CBD, Circular Quay closures from 4am to 11.30am (Macquarie St closed until 4pm)

  • South East, Moore Park to Kingsford closures from 5am to 1.30pm including parts of Anzac Pde, Dacey Ave and Alison Rd - delays are expected in the Eastern Distributor while these closures are in place.

Detours:

Motorists will only be able to travel east/west across the course via the Cross City Tunnel which will be toll-free from 5am to 4.30pm or on surface roads via Gardeners Rd, Bunnerong Rd and Maroubra Rd in the South East. From 1pm motorists can also use Dacey Ave/Alison Rd to travel east or west across the course. The Eastern Distributor Anzac Pde entry and exit will be closed, however the Bondi Moore Park Rd exit will remain open this year.

Thousands of cyclists will take part in either the 50km or the 10km ride for Spring Cycle from North Sydney to Olympic Park via Pyrmont. Road closures will be in place along the first 10km to Pyrmont, from there cyclists will continue on to Olympic Park sharing roads with motorists and abiding by general road rules.

ROAD CLOSURES - 4AM TO 11:30AM:

- Cahill Expressway Lanes 7 & 8 and Circular Quay Overpass and Sydney Harbour Bridge Lanes 3 and 6: two lanes on the Harbour Bridge remain open in each direction under a reduced 40km/h speed limit. 

- North Sydney: Miller St from Falcon St to Pacific Hwy , Berry St from Pacific Hwy to Walker St, sections of Arthur St, Carlow St, Blue St and surrounding local roads including the High St bridge on-ramp.

- Sydney CBD: Hickson Rd / Sussex St from Towns Place to King St and sections of Argyle St, Dalgety Rd and Upper Fort St.

- Western Distributor from Pyrmont to the City including Pyrmont on-ramp, Fig St on-ramp and King St off- ramp. Citybound motorists from the Anzac Bridge will be diverted via the Bathurst St off-ramp to re-join the Harbour Bridge or access City North via Harbour St or Kent St.

- Pyrmont: Pyrmont St, Pyrmont Bridge Rd, Union St, Murray St and surrounding local roads. Pirrrama Rd remains closed until 11.30am.

Some closures will be in place around Sydney Olympic Park between 7:30am and 3pm including sections of Hill Rd, Edwin Flack Ave and Olympic Blvd.
